title: should reset the list to page 1 and strip the page query param when switching folders
verifies: navigating to page 2 of a multi-page folder then switching folders renders page 1 and removes the stale page query param

title: should preserve the current page when returning from a dashboard in the same folder
verifies: opening a dashboard from page 2 and returning to the list restores page 2 instead of resetting to page 1

title: should clamp a stale deep-linked page to page 1 on a single-page folder
verifies: a deep link with page=5 on a single-page folder clamps to page 1 instead of rendering an empty page

title: should clamp to page 1 and render rows when switching to a shorter single-page folder
verifies: switching from page 2 of a long folder to a shorter single-page folder lands on page 1 with rows rendered (no empty flash)
